title: 第8章 升级
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
急匆匆离开北斋的小院后，迫不及待的陈浩甚至没有回沈炼家，他随处找了一处山洞便将意念沉入了侠客系统中。
【侠客系统】
【世界】绣春刀修罗战场
【姓名】沈长青
【身份、背景】主角沈炼堂弟，锦衣卫校尉
【任务】无
【离开时间】随时可以离开（回归地址未知）
【侠客点】（2个）宿主击杀不入流恶人一名，得到1个侠客点，鉴于宿主第一次获取侠客点，系统另赠送宿主（1个侠客点）
【修为】不入流（可用侠客点升级）
【功法】无
【武技】军体拳（小成）三棱军刺（小成）沈家刀法（不入流）
【轻功】八步赶蝉（不入流）
【储物空间】1立方米（可用侠客点升级）
......
这一次的榜单上除了多出两个侠客点，还多了沈家刀法这门武技，更是增加了一个轻功项目。
还有送侠客点的福利？陈浩心里乐开了花。
“系统我现在可以升级吗？”陈浩开心的同时又有些紧张，担心两个侠客点不够升级所需。
“可以，你想升级哪一项在心里默念一声就可以。”听到系统的答复陈浩深呼出一口气。
“那一个侠客点能加多少等级呢？”陈浩继续问道，这也是他重点关注的。
“鉴于你目前的武技等级太低，1个侠客点可以提升两级，等级越高的武技需要的侠客点就越多。”

陈浩是个务实的人，更高级别的武技在这方世界是不存在的，将侠客点用在现有的武技上才是正途，他可不会脑袋犯浑的将侠客点积攒起来等下一个世界得到高级武技再用！
加哪一项呢？一遍又一遍的扫过榜单，陈浩在反复思量。
军体拳、在绣春刀这个用兵器的世界不合适、排除！
三棱军刺术、偏向于刺杀、暗袭，以绣春刀世界的工业能力，很难锻造出合适的三棱军刺、排除！
沈家刀法、沈炼凭借着这套刀法在绣春刀世界能排进前十、陈浩练了十余天招式套路也颇为熟悉了、待定。
八步赶蝉、轻功身法，遇到强敌打不过还可以逃跑，绝对的保命功法啊、待定。
左思右想陈浩在沈家刀法、和八步赶蝉两者之间摇曳不定、这两门武功各有特色，真是让人难以取舍。
“2个侠客点全部升级沈家刀法！”又思考了一小会，陈浩终于下定了决心，他从小就明白一个道理“万事通不如一事精”分散将两门武技升级到中流，倒远不如把其中一门提升到巅峰！
况且陈浩目前最需要的还是一门武技，轻功只能用于逃跑，而刀法却可以继续诛杀恶人获取侠客点。
陈浩默念完升级，榜单立时发生了变化。
【侠客点】无
【武技】沈家刀法圆满
......
这就是圆满级别的沈家刀法吗？榜单变化的同时陈浩同样发生了变化，他突然发觉沈家刀法的招式套路变得极为通透，以前不懂得问题现在豁然开朗。
他早把这方世界的武技等级研究透彻了、等级分为入门、小成、大成、圆满、超神、五个级别，他判断沈炼就处于沈家刀法的圆满阶段，而今能够和沈炼同级他很满意。
“刀来！”
陈浩一声轻唤，放在储物空间内的绣春刀无声无息的回到了他的手中。
刀影重重！
绣春刀在手，陈浩轻轻一跺地面身体在空中来了一个旋转，旋转的同时绣春刀疾风暴雨般向前方劈砍，他出刀如电，一道道刀影在半空中纵横交错，如同光网。
“一秒钟出了九刀！”

陈浩开心的笑了笑，他曾见过沈炼用过此招，他当时还计算了，沈炼差不多也是一秒钟九刀，也就是说他的实力已不在沈炼之下。
将绣春刀重新收回空间，陈浩舒展了一下身体，感觉浑身上下都是使不完的力气，他明白系统不只是提升了刀法境界，也将他的身体素质给提升了，虽然还是瘦弱的身板，但是力量和速度已经不可同日而语。
正所谓人逢喜事精神爽，原本陈浩打算在山洞住上一夜的，无奈精神太亢奋怎么都睡不着，于是他又准备回家。
回家后他发现沈炼还没回来，他也没觉得奇怪，毕竟死了个总旗，肯定要给上面汇报的。
这一夜，陈浩睡得很不舒服，但第二天却精神饱满不见一丝疲累。
陈浩和往常一样，练完功就去了百户所，一天的时间里他始终不见沈炼的身影，等傍晚“放衙”回家的时候他被人堵在了门口。

content_en:
After hurriedly leaving Beizhai's small courtyard, Chen Hao couldn't wait to return to Shen Lian's house. He found a cave everywhere and sunk his mind into the knight system.
【Xia Ke System】
【World】Xiuchundao Shura Battlefield
【Name】Shen Changqing
[Identity, Background] The protagonist Shen Lian’s cousin, the Jinyi Guards School Captain
【Task】None
[Leave time] You can leave at any time (return address unknown)
[Knight Points] (2 points) The host kills a bad villain and gets 1 Knight Point. Since the host obtains Knight Points for the first time, the system will give the host (1 Knight Point) as a gift.
[Cultivation] Not good enough (can be upgraded with knight points)
【Exercise】None
[Martial Arts] Military Fist (Xiaocheng) Triangular Military Thorn (Xiaocheng) Shen Family Sword Technique (Not good enough)
【Qinggong】Eight steps to catch the cicada (not into the flow)
[Storage space] 1 cubic meter (can be upgraded with knight points)
...
This time, in addition to two more knight points, the Shen Family Sword Technique was added to the list, and a light kung fu event was also added.
Are there any benefits like giving knight points? Chen Hao felt happy.
"Can I upgrade the system now?" Chen Hao was happy but a little nervous at the same time, worried that the two knight points were not enough to upgrade.
"Okay, just say whichever item you want to upgrade silently in your mind." Chen Hao took a deep breath when he heard the system's reply.
"How many levels can one knight point add?" Chen Hao continued to ask, which was also his focus.
"Since your current martial arts level is too low, one knight point can be used to upgrade it by two levels. The higher the martial skill level, the more knight points it requires."
Chen Hao is a pragmatic person. Higher-level martial arts do not exist in this world. It is the right way to use knight points on existing martial arts. He will not be stupid and accumulate knight points to wait for the next world to obtain high-level martial arts before using them!
Which one to add? Scanning the list over and over again, Chen Hao was thinking over and over again.
Juntiquan and Xiuchundao are not suitable in the world of weapons and are excluded!
The three-edged military thorn technique is biased toward assassinations and secret attacks. With the industrial capabilities of the Xiuchundao world, it is difficult to forge a suitable three-edged military thorn and eliminate it!
Shen Lian's sword skills are ranked among the top ten in the Xiuchundao world with this set of sword skills. Chen Hao has practiced the moves and routines for more than ten days and is quite familiar with them. To be determined.
Eight steps to chase cicadas, light body movements, you can still run away when you encounter a strong enemy but you can't beat them. It's an absolute life-saving technique, to be determined.
I kept thinking about Chen Hao's vacillation between the Shen family swordsmanship and the eight-step cicada-catching technique. These two martial arts have their own characteristics, which makes it really difficult to choose.
"Use 2 knight points to upgrade the Shen family's sword skills!" After thinking for a while, Chen Hao finally made up his mind. He has understood a truth since he was a child: "It is better to be a jack of all trades than to be an expert at one thing." It is far better to upgrade two martial arts to the middle level than to upgrade one of them to the peak!
Moreover, what Chen Hao needs most right now is a martial arts skill. Qinggong can only be used for escaping, but sword skills can continue to kill villains to gain knight points.
After Chen Haomo finished reading the upgrade, the list immediately changed.
[Xia Ke Point] None
【Martial Arts】The Shen family’s sword skills are perfect
...
Is this the perfect level of Shen family swordsmanship? As the list changed, Chen Hao also changed. He suddenly found that the moves and routines of the Shen family swordsmanship had become extremely clear. Problems that he didn't understand before were now suddenly clear to him.
He had already thoroughly studied the levels of martial arts in this world. The levels were divided into five levels: Beginner, Small Success, Dacheng, Perfection, and Super God. He judged that Shen Lian was at the perfection stage of the Shen family's swordsmanship. Now he was very satisfied to be on the same level as Shen Lian.
"Here comes the knife!"
Chen Hao called softly, and the Xiuchun knife placed in the storage space returned to his hand silently.
The sword shadow is heavy!
With Xiuchun Dao in hand, Chen Hao lightly stomped the ground and his body spun in the air. While spinning, Xiuchun Dao slashed forward like a storm., he drew his sword like lightning, and the sword shadows criss-crossed in mid-air, like a network of light.
"Nine knives were fired in one second!"
Chen Hao smiled happily. He had seen Shen Lian use this move before. He also calculated at the time that Shen Lian could strike almost nine times per second, which meant that his strength was no longer inferior to Shen Lian's.
Retracting the Xiuchundao into space, Chen Hao stretched his body and felt that his whole body was full of endless strength. He understood that the system not only improved the realm of swordsmanship, but also improved his physical fitness. Although he was still thin, his strength and speed were no longer the same.
As the saying goes, people feel refreshed during happy events. Chen Hao originally planned to stay in a cave for one night, but he was too excited to fall asleep, so he planned to go home.
After returning home, he found that Shen Lian hadn't come back yet, and he didn't feel surprised. After all, the death of a general had to be reported to the superiors.
That night, Chen Hao slept very uncomfortable, but the next day he was full of energy and not tired at all.
As usual, Chen Hao went to Baihusuo after practicing the exercises. He never saw Shen Lian throughout the day. When he went home from the office in the evening, he was blocked at the door.
